objective: Verify that one shared fold pass reproduces the two confirmed bounded-shortlist component scores and materially reduces their combined runtime.

component_scores.broad_rff: rff64_mean8_k4 null-adjusted kernel-alignment score at feature bandwidth 4.0

shared_algorithm: Construct each train-fold SAVE block once.
Construct each train-fold RFF-mean block once.
Concatenate equal-weight row-normalized SAVE and RFF-mean blocks.
Fit one SAVE+RFF ContinuousOverlapIndex selector per fold.
Compute the SAVE+RFF current score from that model.
Reuse its feature-independent fitted target scaling and the retained RFF-mean rows to compute broad-RFF kernel alignment.
Do not fit the broad-RFF prototype model or compute unused SAVE+RFF kernel alignment.
legacy_comparator: Run the frozen rff64_mean8_k4 and save_rffmean_k4 evaluators independently with identical folds, seeds, permutation banks, and inputs.

timing.warmup: One legacy and one shared evaluation on the first frozen candidate, excluded from all rows.
timing.order: Alternate legacy-first and shared-first by family position plus candidate position.

verification.rank_groups: Exact equality for broad, SAVE+RFF, and the bounded top-five rule.

speed_gate.metric: median across six families of shared panel wall seconds divided by legacy panel wall seconds
speed_gate.interpretation: At least 25% lower median end-to-end component evaluation time.

decision: Pass only if every score/rank check is exact, all 96 rows are complete and finite, and the speed gate passes.
scope: Experimental shared-computation validation only. No public API or confirmed ranking formula changes.
